articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI appointment highlights urgent need for Section 702 surveillance reform. When political hacks control mass spying powers, constitutional rights become just another casualty of the surveillance state.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
